provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Coding Plan (China site)

free_tier.stated: no free plan is listed. The plan page lists one paid plan: Pro at CNY 200 a month, with the first month at CNY 39.90 for first-time subscribers, for up to 6,000 requests per 5 hours, 45,000 requests per week and 90,000 requests per month
free_tier.notes: one request is one model call; new slots are restocked daily at 09:30:00 UTC+08:00

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible base URL https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1 and Anthropic-compatible base URL https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic, with a plan key that starts with sk-sp-. Supported models: qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.6-plus, kimi-k2.5, glm-5 and MiniMax-M2.5, and also qwen3.5-plus
tooling: the clients that the vendor lists on the plan page, among them Claude Code, Qwen Code, Cursor and OpenClaw; the user sets the plan key and the plan base URL in the client
chaining: the Qwen Code auth menu offers this plan for the Beijing region with the endpoint https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1; the international edition of the same plan has its own record and needs a different account

limits.value: up to 6,000 requests per 5 hours, as a rolling window
up to 45,000 requests per week, reset every Monday at 00:00:00 UTC+08:00
up to 90,000 requests per month, reset at 00:00:00 UTC+08:00 on the subscription renewal date

limits_note: the same three request caps as the international edition; the first one reached pauses calls
binding_note: the identity gate fails before any quota binds and is not a term of the constraint vocabulary; the three request caps apply at once once an account exists

identity_cost.detail: The China site registers accounts with a mobile number from the Chinese mainland and requires individual or enterprise real-name verification before any purchase or use of cloud resources. Individual verification uses a real-name verified personal Alipay account, or a name and an identity card number with a face scan. The international site is a separate account system that does not share accounts

reliability_note: Pro slots sell first come, first served with a daily restock at 09:30:00 UTC+08:00, so a plan can be sold out; a key used by scripts or application backends can be suspended or revoked
confidence_note: price, quota, base URLs and the identity requirements are quoted from the vendor pages read on 2026-11-02. The quota is the vendor's published number and is not a measurement
